triton app info --device <ios-real-target> --platform ios --scope real --bundle-id com.example.app --json

triton app uninstall --platform harmony --device harmony-a --bundle com.example.app --confirm --json
triton app launch --device iphone15 --bundle-id com.example.app --env FEATURE_FLAG=1 --arg debug-route --arg demo.home --json
triton app launch --device android-a --platform android --package-name com.example.app --json
triton app launch --platform harmony --device harmony-a --bundle com.example.app --ability EntryAbility --json
triton app launch --device <ios-real-target> --platform ios --scope real --bundle-id com.example.app --json
triton app launch --platform harmony --bundle com.example.app --ability EntryAbility --json
triton app open-url example://debug --device android-a --platform android --package-name com.example.app --json

triton app open-url --platform harmony --device harmony-a --bundle com.example.app --ability EntryAbility example://debug --json
triton app terminate --device android-a --platform android --package-name com.example.app --json

triton app container --device iphone15 --bundle-id com.example.app --kind data --json

triton app prefs set SeedState --type data --base64 W3t9XQ== --device iphone15 --bundle-id com.example.app --json

commands.outputSemantics: Use app for host-side install, launch, terminate, open-url, container, and preferences across iOS Simulator, Android Emulator, and Harmony Emulator. For iOS runtime readiness, prefer open-url with --wait-ready --snapshot; for Android host flows, verify business completion with wait/observe/screenshot or smoke evidence. If `triton camera on` enabled the launched iOS Simulator bundle, app launch injects the configured camera hook environment.
